svg.title: MAP-ENV-001 GM Controlled Local Schematic v001
svg.desc: North-up, non-metric approved local schematic. Only GEO-000003, GEO-000004, GEO-000007, GEO-000009 and ROUTE-000001 through ROUTE-000004 / GXR-000010 through GXR-000013 are in scope. GEO-000003 is represented at its principal-gate interface for this local view, not as a Keep centroid or footprint. GEO-000004 is represented at its threshold/lamp exterior interface, not as a House centroid or footprint. ROUTE-000001 and ROUTE-000002 line geometry and O-G/O-L positive sight lines are APPROVED for v001. ROUTE-000003 and ROUTE-000004 remain non-geometric. No wall footprint, building frontage, terrain, distance, travel time, scale, road width, choke point, or unregistered geography is established.

CONTROL NOTES
Approved v001 local geometry
• ROUTE-000001 and ROUTE-000002 are APPROXIMATE at local-schematic scale.
• The two approved routes do not share a segment or junction in v001.
This is a v001 layout fact, not a rule for future revisions.
• O-G and O-L are approved positive observation positions.
No claim is made that other points can or cannot see either target.
• No occlusion model is supplied. Unknown blockers are not invented.
• Zero choke points is the approved v001 result.
No choke point is added for dramatic or investigative convenience.
• GEO-000003 is anchored at its gate interface for this view only.
No Keep centroid, wall side, wall polygon, or gate-facing segment is claimed.
• GEO-000004 is anchored at the threshold/lamp interface for this view only.
No House centroid, frontage, building face, property line, or footprint is claimed.
• Tarl Yard is contextual only; ROUTE-000004 is not drawn.
• ROUTE-000003 remains operationally established but physically unknown.
• No numeric distance, travel time, road width, map scale, grid, or hex.
• No terrain, vegetation, ditch, ravine, bridge, ford, stream, or extra structure.
• Unknown local space is intentionally blank.
• No B2, Mystara, or external-source arrangement supplies geometry.
